issue.title: Bead-scale gate ratio:ready can never pass: ready output grows with the corpus active set (41 to 171 rows, 1x to 4x), and the sase-1h8.14 pass verdict was load noise

task_type_fields.impact: Full CI perf-floors stays red, which blocks ci_watch release merges until the gate measures closed-history independence correctly.
task_type_fields.repro:
Found by the sase-1io.7 land agent (sase-1io.7.land) while working out why Full CI `perf-floors` stays red.

`just bead-perf-scale-gate` (added by sase-1h8.14 in 10385fe3c3, wired into Full CI `perf-floors`) blocks on one criterion, `ratio:ready` (ceiling 1.5 = 1 + tolerance 0.5). It has failed on every Full CI run since it landed:

- run 37947270619 (73f593a3a5, core pin 01b0ad73): ready p95 5.4ms @1x -> 15.5ms @4x, ratio 2.849
- run 37963193136 (4dec143bc2, core pin 844b6c1d): ready p95 4.5ms @1x -> 14.9ms @4x, ratio 3.329

Local reproduction (athena, sase-core-rs 0.37.2, load ~9): `bead_read_facade.ready` 30-run median 5.68ms @1x vs 13.92ms @4x. `.venv/bin/python tests/perf/bench_bead_scale.py --scale 1 --scale 4 --runs 3 --only ready --check-gate --gate-tolerance 0.5 ...` -> ratio:ready FAIL 1.793.

Root cause: the scaled synthetic corpus (tests/perf/_bead_corpus.py) multiplies the active set along with closed history (6,899 -> 27,807 beads, 561 -> 2,057 active). `bead_ready` returns 41 rows at 1x and 171 rows at 4x, so its per-row work (`ready_ids_in` / `has_active_blocker_in` / `load_ids_in` in sase-core `crates/sase_core/src/bead/read_model/queries.rs`, plus Python `issues_from_list` hydration) grows about 4.2x. strace of one warm call shows SQLite `pread64` going from 694 to 2,784, and no stat sweep. Closed history is not what moves it. No core change between pins 5c4033f6 and 01b0ad73 touched the read model, and the fail predates the sase-1io.7 cache-race fix (5c5bcdc4).

The `ratio:ready passes (1.03)` verdict in docs/perf_runbook.md came from load noise. Its own artifact sdd/plans/202610/perf_artifacts/bead_perf_gate.json (core 5c4033f6, load ~27) is non-monotonic: 34.9 / 59.5 / 62.5 / 38.5 ms median at 1x/2x/4x/8x, while the clean-window 1x probe was 4.1 ms.

Two possible fixes: (a) make the gate measure what A1 means (closed-history independence). For example, give the ratio corpora a fixed active set while closed history scales, or normalize ready by returned rows. Then take `ratio:ready` back off `--gate-allow`. (b) Bound or page ready serving the way sase-1iw proposes for list. Separately, `has_active_blocker_in` re-`prepare`s two statements per ready row and per dependency. `prepare_cached` or one JOIN would cut ready's per-row cost whichever fix is chosen.

Impact: until this is resolved, Full CI `perf-floors` is red on every run, which blocks `ci_watch` from merging release PRs (the sase 0.18.0 release, epic sase-1io.7). The sase-1io.7 remaining-work plan records `ratio:ready` as a known miss owned by this bead so the gate reports it without blocking.

issue.creation_reason: Full CI perf-floors has been red on ratio:ready on every run since sase-1h8.14 added the gate. The sase-1io.7 landing found that the criterion measures active-set growth rather than closed history, and the gate needs an owning bead for the known miss.
